title: Each mizaj on a foggy winter morning
caption:
7 am, thick fog outside, razai on top. Who actually gets up?

Unani tradition says winter feels different for every mizaj: easier for the warm ones, heavier for the cool ones. From the Damvi who opens everyone's curtains to the Balghami negotiating with the razai, here's your foggy morning, explained.

Traditional wellness wisdom, not medical advice.
